outcome: DNA methylation of the PPARGC1A promoter in placental tissue
DNA methylation of the PPARGC1A promoter in cord blood
cohort: 58 mothers who underwent uncomplicated Caesarean delivery
finding: Maternal gestational glucose levels were positively correlated with placental DNA methylation and negatively correlated with cord blood DNA methylation of the PPARGC1A promoter in a CpG site-specific manner.
